notes_for_editor: Single source: the tnlandforms Georgia tower list (entry GA105). Searches turned up the Smarr community and an unrelated 2021 fire station story in Monroe County, but no lookout history; none of that is cited. Wikipedia's Smarr article gives a community point about 1 km from the list coordinates, so the name may not tie the tower to the community; the story does not say it does. The list prints no unit for elevation; read as feet, as the record does. Nothing is known about build date, staffing, fate or access. Checks worth making: Monroe County Historical Society; Georgia Archives; NHLR and FFLOS registers if a listing exists.
